offering_description.value: Builds and maintains infrastructure for telecommunications, clean energy, utility and oil and gas companies. Performs engineering, construction and maintenance under multi-year contracts with asset owners and operators across North America.

primary_services.value: engineering; construction; fiber and wireless network installation; power transmission and distribution construction; pipeline construction; maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecommunications carriers, cable operators, electric and gas utilities, pipeline operators, renewable energy developers

end_markets.value: telecommunications; clean energy; utilities; oil and gas; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: construction contracts for network, power and pipeline projects, often under multi-year master service agreements; service fees: recurring maintenance, repair and engineering services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in engineering and construction work, sells installation and maintenance services to infrastructure owners

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: communications infrastructure, clean energy and utility infrastructure, oil and gas pipeline infrastructure, sharing construction and engineering capabilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and contracts awarded directly by telecom, utility, energy and pipeline customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: worker safety and environmental rules, utility and pipeline standards, and permitting for energy and telecom construction
